evidence.locomotion: Walk is still clean (plantedFootSpeed 0.284, 1.10 m/s steady). Run and sprint slip is unchanged from r3: punch_walker 2.51, shore 2.01, sprint_stop 2.72, shove 3.02 m/s. The r3 snap at the lip is gone. In sprint_stop the input is released at frame 66 at 2.00 m/s and speed eases 2.00 -> 1.15 -> 0.35 -> 0 over 18 frames, with no one-frame drop. The new edge brake has a sawtooth: the speed rises by 0.23 m/s every 5-6 frames while braking (sprint_stop 53->54 4.13->4.36, 59->60 2.97->3.20, 64->65 2.05->2.28; shore 77->78 3.23->3.47, 83->84, 86->87). The cause is that tgt is quantised to the 0.15 m probe step (player.js 88-89), and line 92 lets the player re-accelerate at 7 m/s^2 between steps. In shove f018 (frame 36, d = 0.05) the player runs straight through the downed ped's torso.
evidence.responsiveness: Melee input is much better. punch_walker: the press at frame 15 swings at frame 34 and lands at frame 42, so 0.9 s press-to-impact against 1.5 s in r3. The approach ramps 0 -> 3.9 m/s in 0.3 s (acc 13). Presses made during the approach are now queued: the press at frame 33 became the chained cross at frame 49. Presses are still dropped. Four presses gave three swings, because the press at 1.7 s (frame 51) sets C.next = 0.3 s (player.js 218), and that buffer expires around frame 61. The cross that started at frame 49 (0.53 s, plus a 0.07 s hit-stop) only reaches atk.t 0.62 at about frame 62. The swing came from the next press, at frame 69. punch_approach and knockout gave 3/3 and 4/4 presses to swings. The 4th knockout swing (frame 65) whiffs at a downed body.
evidence.camera: Fight framing now pulls in (dist lerp to max(3.4, 0.85*dist)). Player and opponent both stay readable in punch_approach f018-f039 and knockout f003-f009, with no clipping in any capture. The lock-on swing is still big: punch_walker f012 -> f015 re-frames from the towers to The Landing in 0.3 s, because the swing combines the 1.5 rad/s yaw clamp with the 40% target shift toward the opponent. FOV and shake are restrained. The camera bubble and sightline pushes kept walkers out of the frame.
evidence.combat: Punches connect reliably: punch_walker, punch_approach and knockout each landed 3/3. The approach now catches a walker, which r3 could not do: d 3.1 -> 1.81 at the swing, then 1.04 at impact. Block feedback is now distinct (index.js 198). Problems: (1) Every KO in the capture is exactly jab -> cross -> hook, with hits 3 at frames 78, 95 and 49. DMG 26/38/55 x0.8-1.2, plus the hook-KO rule at hp < 45 (peds.js 156), makes 3 hits a guaranteed KO. (2) Peds still never land a counter. Through the whole knockout capture the health bar stays calm, which needs health > 99 (hud.js 145). Each stagger (0.42 s) resets nothing on F.cd (0.9-1.5 s), so a 0.6 s combo locks the fighter out. (3) Cops still cannot be targeted, because findTarget only walks peds.list (index.js 189), and they are not in player.bodies(). (4) C.chain is not cleared when the target goes down, so queued presses throw at a body.
evidence.world_boundaries: The body pin is fixed. In shove the knockdown at frame 27 drops the speed 6.03 -> 3.72 (stumble once), then the player re-accelerates 3.0 -> 6.2 m/s straight past the body. There is no pin, against d 0.72 at under 0.5 m/s for 0.8 s in r3. The river edge is solid in all 9 scenarios (endInWater false). shore stops at z -160.83, 0.78 m off the lip, with no running on the spot for frames 94-120, and sprint_stop holds still from frame 84. The playtest assertion is no longer vacuous (z < -159.9, y > 1.5). Remaining issues: the 0.15 m probe sawtooth (see locomotion), the player clipping through bodies at d 0.05, and a stop 0.78 m short of the lip, which is conservative.
evidence.npc_behaviour: A real step up. S.scare (peds.js 114-122) now splits into flee (55%, always within 3 m), cower (25%, 3-5 s, crouch clip) and film (20% beyond 6 m, phone or photo, 5-8 s). A witness phones it in: the call takes 4 s, then 1 star and a scanner text. This works end to end. In punch_approach, f024 shows 'POLICE SCANNER: Assault reported by a member of the public' at frame 72, and the star and CAR x1 follow at f027. That is only 15 frames after punch_approach's own first hit, so it is the call from punch_walker's KO, which survived the scenario's wanted.reset(). A sprint knockdown now scares people within 10 m, counts as an assault, and 45% of victims come back to fight (peds.js 189). An idle ped whose fight ends returns to 'idle'. Bugs: (1) witnessCall (index.js 175) can pick a ped that is fleeing, staggering or jogging, the COLLECT mark, or a previous victim. A previous victim has q.assaulted set, so updateCalls (line 181) cancels on the next frame. It also only requires the caller to be more than 2.5 m from the victim, not from the player, so peds.js 223 can cancel a caller standing near the player at once. Either way nobody calls and nobody retries. (2) p.assaulted is never cleared, not even on respawn. Once a ped has been KO'd, line 158 returns before copsNear, so beating them again in front of the police is never a crime. (3) Cower and film never show in any capture frame. (4) The flee 'yaw += PI/2' snap at the quay (peds.js 240) and the skipped personal-space push when nearP < 3 (245) are both still unfixed.
evidence.hud_ux: Phone frames (phone/f000-f004, captured 16:30, after the ui.css edit at 15:51) show the new placement: the location toast sits under the cash on the right, no objective is shown, and nothing covers the player. I rebuilt the touch HUD from template.html and ui.css at 844x390 and measured the elements. (1) With the hull bar shown, .bar.hull is [16,165,198,178] and .live-head is [14,166,168,179], so the LIVE badge lands exactly on the hull bar. Both appear together, on ferry boarding (mission.js goLive(26) plus hud.setHull). (2) .loc b [669,84,830,108] overlaps .wanted .stars [653,84,774,105], and .loc [..121] overlaps .units [653,109,774,122]. .wanted keeps its layout space at opacity 0, and loc top was set to 84 px rather than under the units, so every zone change during a chase draws the place name over the stars. The objective is now bottom-centre [253,318,591,376]: a 3-line HEAT objective clears the stick (x 64-172) and ENTER (x 656). ENTER is still dimmed rather than hidden. Nothing marks the caller, so the new 'stop the witness' play is invisible on a phone.
evidence.feedback: Blocks now read differently: 0.03 s hit-stop, shake 0.1, impact_concrete at rate 1.6, no flesh sound and 8 ms of haptics (index.js 198). Haptics now fire on hits (16/30/45 ms by kind or KO), on being hit (22) and on a sprint knockdown (25). A sprint knockdown also gets a 0.3 shake and an impact sound. The scanner text plus the star gives the witness call a visible consequence (punch_approach f024-f027), and the minimap turns pink on a manhunt. Still missing: hit sparks, decals and dust on knockdowns, and any audio for the witness pulling out a phone. Haptics are silent on iOS, where navigator.vibrate is undefined.
evidence.fun_loop: The minute-to-minute beat improved. Assaults now open a 4 s window in which you can chase down or flatten the caller. A sprint knockdown is a crime, and 45% of those victims return for a fight. COLLECT texts once only on foot, and car.keep and isMark are released on cancel and fail. The HEAT text now says how to reach 2 stars. Still blocking: (1) jobs.js 44 keeps every street job locked until the ferry mission is done. (2) The HEAT route says 'do it again with the cops watching', but at 1 star an assault only escalates when a unit is within 60 m (index.js 159). The same victim never counts twice (index.js 158), and cops cannot be punched. (3) Peds never counter, so fights have no risk.
evidence.stability: No page errors in any of the 9 scenarios, no water entries, and no stuck states in capture: the body pin, the COLLECT DOM spam and the BOOST car leak are all gone. New lifecycle problems: (1) calls[] lives outside wanted, so a pending call outlives wanted.reset(). This is seen in punch_approach f024. In game, updateCalls also runs while state.mode === 'dead', so a call can post 'Units responding' and a star during the WASTED or BUSTED screen. (2) p.comeBack is only cleared when it fires, so if the victim gets up while the player is in a car, the flag stays armed for a later traffic knockdown. (3) jobs.js 72 forces m.state = 'fight' without stopGesture, so a mark caught filming or calling fights with a phone animation. (4) p.assaulted never expires. Verification gaps: index.js was modified at 16:31:50, after the last capture (16:30:56), and the respawn cleanup of callers at index.js 86 is not exercised in any scenario. docs/play/STATUS.md has no 'After play-r3' section (its rounds table stops at play-r1), so the changes were checked against the code alone.

fixes.fix: Make witness calls robust. In witnessCall (line 175), only consider q where ['walk','idle','film','cower'].includes(q.state) && q.kind !== 'jog' && !q.isMark && !(q.assaultedT > state.t - 45) && Math.hypot(q.ch.position.x - player.x, q.ch.position.z - player.z) > 4. Prefer 'film' and 'cower' peds: score = d - (q.state === 'film' ? 8 : q.state === 'cower' ? 4 : 0). Replace the permanent per-victim flag in onHit (line 158) with a timed one: if (p.assaultedT > state.t - 45 && !(ko && p.assaulted !== 'ko')) return; p.assaultedT = state.t; p.assaulted = ko ? 'ko' : true. In updateCalls (line 181), cancel on c.q.assaultedT > c.t0 (set c.t0 = state.t at push) instead of c.q.assaulted. In respawn (line 86), also do for (const q of peds.list) { q.assaulted = false; q.assaultedT = -1e9; q.comeBack = false; }. Show the caller: while a call is pending, call hud.callMark(headPos, c.t / 4), a red phone glyph that reuses the .lockon element style with a draining ring.

Fix the two measured phone overlaps at 844x390. (1) The LIVE badge on the hull bar: line 188 changes 'top: calc(166px ...)' to 'top: calc(186px + env(safe-area-inset-top))'. In the line 189 media query, set 'body.touch .live-chat { height: 40px; }' so .live spans y 186-229, clear of the hull bar (ends at 178) and the stick ghost (starts at 230). (2) The location toast on the stars: line 192 changes 'top: calc(84px ...)' to 'top: calc(128px + env(safe-area-inset-top))', which puts it under .units (ends at 122) and above JUMP (starts at 204). In touch.js line 49, replace the dim toggle with bAction.hidden = !c.inVehicle && !c.canEnter. Add both cases to a playtest step that asserts no intersecting rects among .bar.hull, .live, .loc, .wanted and .units with body.touch and everything shown.

Stop dropping presses made mid-swing. Line 218: replace 'else C.next = 0.3' with 'else C.next = atk ? Math.max(0.3, (0.62 - atk.t) * atk.dur + 0.2) : 0.3', so a press made during a 0.53 s cross lives until the cancel window opens. Clear queued chains when the target is gone: after line 243, add 'if (C.target && C.target.ch.state !== "ok") C.chain = 0;'. At line 226/232, if a press finds no standing target but a downed one within 1.6 m, don't throw a standing punch at air: skip the attack and set C.next = null, or play a short kick gesture. Target: punch_walker gives 4 presses -> 4 swings, and knockout throws no swing after the KO.

Let fighters punch back, and stop the fixed 3-hit KO. In the stagger exit (line 198), when p.fight is set, add 'p.fight.cd = Math.min(p.fight.cd, 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.25);', so a fighter answers right after a hit instead of being locked out by a 0.6 s combo. In the fight branch (line 206), allow the swing from d < 1.6. Damage: DMG = { jab: [16, 28], cross: [26, 40], hook: [38, 58] }, rolled uniformly. Line 156: KO only when hp <= 0, or on a hook when hp < 30. Track p.hitsTaken and give a 15% chance per hit (after the 2nd) to drop the guard into a 0.5 s 'stunned' flinch. Target: KO in 3-5 hits, and in a scripted 6-press fight against a 'fight' ped the player takes at least one counter (health < 100).

Make cops part of the brawl, and make escalation work. Line 189: player.findTarget = (x, z, yaw, r, ang) => peds.findTarget(x, z, yaw, r, ang, wanted.cops). In peds.findTarget, iterate list.concat(extra || []), since cops share ch.position and ch.state. In player.onPunch, if wanted.cops.includes(t), do t.hp = (t.hp ?? 120) - dmg, call t.ch.flinch(...) or t.ch.knockDown(...) at hp <= 0, then wanted.setMin(Math.max(2, wanted.stars + 1)), and return before peds.punched. Line 190: player.bodies = () => ({ peds: peds.list.concat(wanted.cops), cars: traffic.cars }). Line 159: escalate when stars >= 1 and any unit is within 120 m, so 'do it again with the cops watching' happens while a pursuit closes in: if (wanted.stars >= 1 ? copsNear(x, z, 120) : copsNear(x, z)) wanted.add(1, how).

Unlock street jobs before the ferry mission (carried over from r3, not done). Pass mission into createJobs (index.js line 59). At line 44, replace 'if (!missionDone) return' with 'if (!missionDone && !(mission.step === "goto" && mission.t > 90)) return', so the first BOOST, HEAT or COLLECT offer arrives 90 s into a session if the player is roaming instead of heading to the jetty. Line 72: call m.ch.stopGesture() before forcing state 'fight'. Line 71: if m.state is 'call', 'film' or 'cower', drop it from any pending witness call first.

Remove the edge-brake sawtooth (+0.23 m/s every 5-6 frames in sprint_stop 53-65 and shore 77-87). At line 89, refine the first blocked sample by bisection: lo = dd - 0.15, hi = dd; repeat 4 times with mid = (lo + hi) / 2, setting walkable(mid) ? lo = mid : hi = mid; then t2 = Math.sqrt(11 * Math.max(0, lo - 0.45)). After the probe loop, if (edgeBrake) tgt = Math.min(tgt, P.speed), so the player never re-accelerates toward an edge. Bodies: in the downed-ped branch (line 163), when P.speed > 1.2 and stumbleT > 0, still apply a 0.4x lateral push, so the player passes beside the torso instead of through it (shove frame 36, d 0.05).

Tie call lifetimes to game state. At the top of updateCalls (line 179), add 'if (state.mode !== "playing") return;', so no scanner text or star fires under WASTED or BUSTED. Wrap wanted.reset in setup so it also clears calls: const _reset = wanted.reset; wanted.reset = () => { for (const c of calls.splice(0)) if (c.q.state === 'call') { c.q.ch.stopGesture(); c.q.state = 'flee'; c.q.fleeT = 3; } _reset(); }. This also stops harness scenarios leaking stars into each other, as in punch_approach f024. In peds.js line 189, clear p.comeBack in the else branch as well. In peds.js line 240, replace 'p.yaw += Math.PI * 0.5' for fleeing peds with a turn along the shore: the yaw toward the next waypoint if p.path exists, otherwise toward the flee origin rotated by +-90 deg, picking the walkable side. Apply it through lerpAngle at 6*dt, not as an instant snap.
